feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 July 2026 4:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 01 July 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by a deepening area of low pressure and associated frontal zone.


##Wind##

West or northwest 2 to 4, soon backing south or southwest 5 to 7, veering west 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the east later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first but with areas of mist and isolated fog patches in the north, then occasional rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog patches/.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, soon veering west or northwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
